public_rationale: Zitron says the companies 'don't really appear to have a way' to cut costs, and that training costs are 'never going away.' The first is a hedged impression. The second has no deadline. Neither names a measure. Grading it would mean adding a cost baseline and threshold he did not give. For context, Anthropic's S-1 shows compute costs rising every quarter in dollars while falling as a share of revenue, which could be read either way.
limitations: Context covers Anthropic only, not OpenAI.
